questions.q: What syntax does a template literal use instead of regular quotes?
options: Backticks (`` ` ``), with ${} for interpolation
Single quotes doubled up ('')
Square brackets
A leading # symbol
questions.explain: Template literals are delimited by backticks and support ${expression} interpolation.

questions.q: In `Total: $${price * quantity}`, what can go inside the ${}?
options: Any valid JavaScript expression, including math and ternaries — not just a bare variable name
Only a single variable name, nothing else
Only string literals
Nothing — ${} is just decorative syntax with no effect
questions.explain: ${} evaluates any valid JavaScript expression and inserts the result into the string.

questions.q: How does a template literal handle a line break typed directly inside the backticks?
options: It becomes a real line break in the resulting string, with no \n escape sequence needed
It causes a syntax error
It's silently removed from the output string
It must be escaped with \n or it won't compile
questions.explain: Template literals support genuine multi-line strings directly in source code.

questions.q: What is a "tagged template" in JavaScript?
options: A template literal immediately preceded by a function name, which receives the literal pieces and interpolated values separately before they're combined
A template literal that includes an HTML tag
A deprecated JavaScript feature removed in ES6
A template literal that can only contain numbers
questions.explain: Tagging lets a function process a template's pieces and values before producing the final string.

questions.q: Why do template literals largely replace string concatenation with + in modern code?
options: It's easier to read at a glance which parts are literal text and which are inserted data
The + operator was removed from JavaScript entirely
Template literals run noticeably faster at runtime in all cases
Concatenation with + no longer works on strings
questions.explain: Readability — seeing the literal text and interpolated values in one coherent string — is the main practical benefit.
